principle: Remove permanent role processes, not domain expertise or mandatory gates.
migration_rules: A task may require multiple domains; do not force a single owner when dependencies are genuinely cross-domain.
Settlement checks remain mandatory where relevant even though settlement ceases to be a permanent standalone role.
Behavioral and informed-flow methods remain named capabilities under Market Research.
Pre-Build Killer and Chief Falsifier remain separate Red Team modes with different depth/trigger semantics.
Independent reproduction remains a promotion gate and gains stronger isolation despite losing permanent-agent status.
No legacy negative evidence or agent finding is deleted during migration.
